assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Deliver one complete 1536x1024 landscape illustration of an EMPTY Fallout vault arena, a game background rather than a promotional poster. Art direction from lore research: The Pitt's Hole supplies the enclosed improvised industrial pit atmosphere; New Vegas Legion arena supplies simple bounded fighting-ground organization; Fallout 4 workshop arenas supply assembled scrap fences and practical corners; Nuka-World Cola-Cars supplies faded pre-war amusement branding repurposed for combat; the Pitt announcer suggests a microphone and PA system. Adapt those influences into a nonlethal vault training room, with no faction affiliation implied.
Overall design: a former Vault-Tec recreation room converted with wasteland repairs. Recognizable 1950s optimism, chunky analog technology, blue/yellow paint, battered metal and funny cheerful sports signage. Crisp 2D Fallout Shelter-like cartoon, confident dark outlines, broad flat colors, two-tone shadows, restrained wear drawn as simple shapes. Warm practical lighting and a muted steel-blue/ochre palette with small red accents. Avoid photorealism, painterly realism, glossy 3D and microscopic detail.
Composition: frontal room cutaway with modest floor perspective, wide continuous rear wall, central round industrial ventilation grille as a recurring room landmark. Empty fighting floor fills lower 40%; leave positions x35% and x65%, y80% entirely clear. Important recognizable props around middle band of rear wall, visible in centered 3:1 crop. No obstructing foreground props. Detail should remain legible as small game-room art.
All tiers share the same physical room and cheerful blue/yellow boxing poster featuring a printed Vault Boy mascot and exact text 'GOOD SPORTSMANSHIP!'. The poster is environmental artwork, not an actual person. Tier-specific additions show practical upgrades to the same room.
Constraints: no actual people, fighters, creatures, crowds, gore, corpses, fire, smoke, radioactive hazards, floor weapons, UI, watermark or title outside environmental signage. Opaque image. Do not replicate the old generic symmetric sci-fi training-room prompt.

TIER 1 DUEL: a humble patched fighting pit. Low mismatched chain-link partitions with welded scrap panels, two worn blue/yellow padded starting corners at the far edges, simple wooden spectator benches tucked against side walls, a cracked ochre ring painted on concrete. Basic lamps and exposed rusted pipes. A small school bell hung near the rear wall, a crude horn speaker, and the peeling boxing poster. Modest improvised repairs with asymmetry. No announcer booth, electronic scoreboard, CRT command console, elevated catwalks or heavy containment infrastructure. No Nuka-Cola advertisement yet. The room is poor but maintained and safe; clear center.

Preserve the recognizable tier-specific architecture, room upgrades, Fallout-inspired props, poster text, illustration style, muted blue/yellow/rust palette and warm lights. Retain a clear empty fighting floor in the lower third, with room for actor positions at x35% and x65%, y82%; do not simply crop away the fighting floor or cut off the posters. Upper two-thirds contains the back wall and essential readable props, and the lower third contains the floor. Keep the visual progression: basic patched Duel room (tier1), reinforced Brawl room with announcer booth and Nuka-Cola sign (tier2), Hunt room with containment gates, beacons, RobCo console and maintenance bay (tier3). This input is Tier 1; retain only that tier's existing equipment.
Opaque image. No actual people, fighters, creatures, weapons, gore, HUD, watermark, extra tiers or multi-panel collage. Generate one single 3:1 panoramic illustration.
